target_model.model_architecture_note: TinyLlama card says it adopts the same architecture and tokenizer family as Llama 2; this is why the Llama eager attention capture path remains the target adapter.

source_facts.fact: HF model page lists License: apache-2.0.
HF tree for the selected revision renders fe8a4ea and marks that tree verified; the full commit is used in the manifest, not the short label.
HF model card says TinyLlama adopts the same architecture and tokenizer as Llama 2 and requires Transformers >=4.34 for basic use.
HF generation docs define max_new_tokens/min_new_tokens, do_sample, num_beams, and use_cache semantics that the trace gate pins.
HF attention interface docs warn that custom attention backends must also register mask formatters or masks can be skipped.
HF cache docs describe DynamicCache/StaticCache behavior and the need for attention masks to include past and current KV length.
